description: Up to 8 same-qualification/same-narrow candidates, open to international students, sorted by CRICOS, not quality. Omit state for nationwide. A state requires both school campus and course–campus relation explicitly open. No candidate does not trigger relaxation. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.
